subtitle.zh: 欧冠联赛阶段 · 安联球场

summary.zh: 2026年10月21日，安联满座。埃泽弱侧脚破门、戴维斯反击扳平、凯恩点球、赖斯轰进这一分。评这一夜，不评队徽。
summary.en: 21 Oct 2026, 75,000 in Munich. Eze's weaker foot, Davies on the break, Kane from the spot, Rice thundered in the point. Grade the night, not the badge.

highlight.zh: 一粒点球，一脚把廷贝尔看穿的直塞。他以为 2-1 能撑过最后八分钟。没有。
highlight.en: One penalty, one pass that undressed Timber, and the face of a man who thought 2-1 would survive eight minutes. It did not.

highlight.zh: 凯恩一送，戴维斯人已经没了，拉亚只看见一道加拿大残影。扳平球是用速度包装的射门。
highlight.en: Kane slid it, Davies was already gone, Raya saw a Canadian blur. The equaliser was pace dressed up as a finish.

highlight.zh: 64 脚传球、成功率 95%。别人在抢集锦，他在当节拍器。
highlight.en: 64 passes at 95%. The quiet German metronome while everyone else auditioned for the highlights package.

highlight.zh: 后点起跳时，绝杀好像已经写好了。拉亚的手没同意。空中不错，零封没有。
highlight.en: Rose at the back post like the winner was already written. Raya's hand disagreed. Aerial night, not a clean sheet night.

highlight.zh: 51 脚传球、两次关键传球、零条头条。在一场 2-2 的马戏里，这几乎是夸奖。
highlight.en: 51 passes, two key ones, zero headlines. In a 2-2 circus that is almost a compliment.

highlight.zh: 半场换下金玟哉。44 分钟干净，一次关键传球。难得的替补登场，没把什么点着。
highlight.en: On at the break for Kim. 44 tidy minutes, one key pass, and the rare sub appearance that did not set anything on fire.

highlight.zh: 哈弗茨开场就放倒他，吃到黄牌。之后他专赢那些没人剪进集锦的无聊对抗。
highlight.en: Havertz fouled him early and got the yellow. Stanišić spent the rest of the night winning the boring duels nobody clips.

highlight.zh: 11 次对抗赢了 3 次。引擎很响，抢断数据去投诉噪音了。
highlight.en: Three duels won out of eleven. The engine was loud. The tackle count filed a noise complaint.

highlight.zh: 两次关键传球，然后被迪亚斯换下。配角演得可以，没轮到第三幕。
highlight.en: Two key passes, then the hook for Díaz. A decent supporting actor who did not get the third act.

highlight.zh: 22 分钟，一脚射正。够提醒慕尼黑他仍是麻烦，不够当主线。
highlight.en: Twenty-two minutes and one shot on target. Enough to remind Munich he is still a problem, not enough to be the plot.

highlight.zh: 把吉马良斯的头球托上横梁，像回到 2014。然后埃泽的弱侧脚和赖斯的晚到重炮走了进来。英雄和受害者，同一双手套。
highlight.en: Turned Guimarães' header onto the bar like it was 2014. Then Eze's weaker foot and Rice's late hammer walked in. Hero and victim, same gloves.

highlight.zh: 半场比赛，一次对抗成功。赖斯开始写结局之前，他已经坐到板凳上。
highlight.en: Half a game, one duel won, and a seat on the bench before Rice started writing the ending.

highlight.zh: 替戴维斯踢了五分钟。一脚传球，成功率零。用眨眼来计时的登场。
highlight.en: Five minutes for Davies. One pass, completion rate zero. A cameo measured in blinks.

highlight.zh: 换下格纳布里，四次对抗全输。他没继承那脚送给拉亚的射门，带了一张更干净的零。
highlight.en: On for Gnabry and lost all four duels. The kid did not inherit the shot at Raya. He brought a cleaner zero.

highlight.zh: 全场第一个机会，低平、客气，直奔拉亚怀里。不是每张国外评分表的垫底，只是大家记错理由的那一脚。
highlight.en: First chance of the night, low and polite, straight at Raya. Not the cellar of every foreign sheet — just the shot everyone remembers for the wrong reason.

highlight.zh: 全场最佳。角球、开场三十分钟，然后和马杜埃凯、约克雷斯做球，一脚把这一分轰回来。英国评分 8.5，五维认。
highlight.en: Player of the match. Corners, the opening half hour, then a link with Madueke and Gyökeres and a strike that took the point. English sheets said 8.5. The five axes agree.

highlight.zh: 第 10 分钟替受伤的萨卡上场。厄德高弧线，弱侧脚打进，边裁先举旗，VAR 发现斯塔尼西奇把他放在了在线位置。第 53 分钟又差一点。英雄允许浪费一次。
highlight.en: On for the injured Saka at 10'. Ødegaard's curl, a weaker-foot finish, a flag that said offside, then VAR noticed Stanišić was playing him on. Went close again at 53'. Heroes get one miss.

highlight.zh: 给埃泽那脚球脏得漂亮。下半场任意球吓唬了一下就蒸发了。晚些被换下时，活已经干完。
highlight.en: The pass for Eze was filthy in the good way. A second-half free kick threatened and then evaporated. Off late, job already done.

highlight.zh: 跟上戴维斯的冲刺，滑铲还铲到了。LiveScore 说他是阿森纳两个中卫里更好的那个。安联听众并不喜欢这句话。
highlight.en: Matched Davies' sprint and still got the slide in. LiveScore called him the better of Arsenal's centre-backs. The Allianz crowd did not enjoy that sentence.

highlight.zh: 后点角球上写着他的名字，他没顶上。后来又差一点吃到第二次垫射。插上仍是性格，终结不是。
highlight.en: A back-post corner with his name on it, and he missed it. Nearly a second flick later. The overlap was still a personality trait; the finish was not.

highlight.zh: 赖斯的角球顶到了，诺伊尔临时发明了一次扑救。69 分钟很稳，然后发动机房交给刘易斯-斯凯利。
highlight.en: Met Rice's corner and watched Neuer invent a save. Solid for 69 minutes, then Lewis-Skelly inherited the engine room.

highlight.zh: 没进球。把赖斯从右侧送进去的那脚，是阿森纳带走一分、而不是一篇「就差一点点」演讲的原因。
highlight.en: No goal. The pass that put Rice through from the right is why Arsenal left Munich with a point instead of a speech about fine margins.

highlight.zh: 左路首发，萨卡倒下后被赶到右路。把廷贝尔顺进禁区，自己半场还把戴维斯晃开。是重组，不是杰作。
highlight.en: Started left, shoved right when Saka folded. Flicked Timber into the box and shrugged Davies off in his own half. A reshuffle, not a masterpiece.

highlight.zh: 1-1 时速度比赛输给戴维斯，接着用手挡下凯恩的射门送了点球。之后有起色，还差点击中一脚被诺伊尔拒绝的世界波。充实的一晚。
highlight.en: Lost the foot race to Davies for 1-1, then handled Kane's shot into a penalty. Improved after that, and still nearly scored a stunner Neuer refused. A full evening.

highlight.zh: 铲到凯恩左脚吃到黄牌，然后用一次封堵、第 56 分钟挡下戴维斯来回答。一张黄牌，然后是足球版的「人还是到了」。
highlight.en: Booked for catching Kane's left foot, then answered with a block and a stop on Davies at 56'. A yellow, and then the football version of showing up anyway.

highlight.zh: 开场放倒斯塔尼西奇吃到黄牌。有一次把埃泽送出去，对方选择了风景路线。还剩二十分钟被换下，绝平是在他不在时造出来的。
highlight.en: Early yellow for clattering Stanišić. Teed Eze up once and watched him take the scenic route. Hooked with twenty minutes left, which is when the equaliser was built without him.

highlight.zh: 开场趴下封住格纳布里，后来横移挡下于帕的头球。凯恩点球扑错方向，戴维斯的贴地射门没有答案。一盘有两个漏洞的集锦。
highlight.en: Down early to smother Gnabry, across later to deny Upamecano's header. Went the wrong way for Kane's penalty and had no answer for Davies' low one. A highlight reel with two plot holes.

highlight.zh: 第 69 分钟换下吉马良斯。真正要紧的那二十分钟，盘子没掉。
highlight.en: On for Guimarães at 69' and did not drop the plate during the only twenty minutes that mattered.

highlight.zh: 十分钟，无球受伤，然后去了边线。LiveScore 拒绝给分。我们给：唯一决定性动作是伤病，而且它不是足球动作。
highlight.en: Ten minutes, off the ball, then the sideline. LiveScore refused to grade him. We will: the injury was the only decisive action, and it was not a football one.

highlight.zh: 绝平之后替厄德高踢了五分钟。素材不够封神，也不够做成梗。职业慢跑。
highlight.en: Five minutes for Ødegaard after the equaliser. Not enough tape to crown him or to meme him. A professional jog.

title.zh: 湖人 vs 凯尔特人

summary.zh: 第四节。按今晚的表现打分，别按生涯名气。
summary.en: Fourth quarter in LA. Grade the stars on this night — not the résumé.

highlight.zh: 组织多于强攻。两次关键协防慢了半步。
highlight.en: Facilitating more than hunting. Two late closeouts were a step slow.

highlight.zh: 后撤步依然准。被紧逼后的失误会撕开评分。
highlight.en: Step-back still money. Turnovers in the press will split the board.

highlight.zh: 不再一味倒手，开始冲击补防。防东契奇是争议点。
highlight.en: Attacking closeouts instead of settling. Defense on Dončić is the debate.

summary.zh: 皇马 2-1。打禁区内的今晚，别打队徽。
summary.en: 2-1 Madrid. Grade the night in the box, not the badge.

highlight.zh: 上半场拉边冲击撕开城防线。最后 20 分钟更多在造犯规。
highlight.en: First-half stretch runs broke City’s line. Final 20 minutes he hunted fouls more than shots.

highlight.zh: 禁区嗅觉仍在。长时间被养空，问题在他还是供给？
highlight.en: Poacher finish. Isolated for long spells — is that on him or the supply?

highlight.zh: 后点插上一次中柱。红牌险后的回追才是打分点。
highlight.en: Late runs, one off the post. Defensive jump after the red-card scare was the real grade.

summary.zh: 可以先打预期分，开球后再覆盖。
summary.en: Pre-game cards allowed. Overwrite them after kickoff.

highlight.zh: 看他对费城伪装防守的第一阅读。
highlight.en: Board is watching the first read vs Philadelphia’s disguised coverage.

highlight.zh: Tush push 还在。早档传球比sneak更能说明问题。
highlight.en: Tush push still exists. Grade the throws on early downs, not just the sneak.

summary.zh: 街道赛、轮胎窗口、那一次永远没出现的超车。给车手打分，别给车子打分。
summary.en: Street circuit, tyre calls, and the pass that never comes. Grade the driver, not the car tweet.

highlight.zh: 主场杆位兑现。控差距而不咬死后胎。
highlight.en: Home streets, clean qualifying converted. Managing the gap without chewing the rears.

highlight.zh: P4 起跑到 P2，没有把车塞进墙里。车轮战大于高光。
highlight.en: Started P4, now P2 without a lunge into the barrier. Racecraft over highlight-reel.

highlight.zh: 挡住勒克莱尔六圈后干净让路。不是每个 P3 都叫崩盘。
highlight.en: Held Leclerc for six laps then yielded clean. Not every P3 is a fade.

title.zh: 辛纳 vs 阿尔卡拉斯

summary.zh: 红土五盘。发球和接发比捧杯照更能说明比赛。
summary.en: Five sets on clay. Serve + return split the match more than the winner’s circle photo.

highlight.zh: 丢首盘后提前抢接发。第五盘放小球是匕首。
highlight.en: Dropped the first set, then started taking returns early. Drop shot in set five was the dagger.

highlight.zh: 首盘控制极狠。第五盘深度浅了两英尺——下限依然高。
highlight.en: First-set control was ruthless. Depth dropped two feet in the fifth — still a high floor.

title.zh: 佩雷拉 vs 安卡拉耶夫

venue.zh: 拉斯维加斯 T-Mobile 球馆

summary.zh: 五回合或一记左勾。评你看见的回合，别评你期待的击倒。
summary.en: Five rounds or a left hook. Grade the round you saw, not the highlight you expected.

highlight.zh: 鞭腿到小腿。摔防比上次卫冕松，评分会分裂。
highlight.en: Calf kicks landing. Less wrestling defense than the last defense — board is split.

highlight.zh: 变向过手是真的。要在左勾找到他之前兑现。
highlight.en: Level changes are real. Needs to cash them before the left hook finds him.
